20b4fd5e0e0499a1e55512a62d132b38d4b2c6a9.subjectAndBody:
Remove node mode and the workflow hub

The canvas is the main workspace; node mode and the workflow hub are retired
ahead of the drama workbench.

- WorkspaceMode is now canvas | drama | dashboard. Legacy mode=node and
  mode=workflow-hub URLs open drama. The canvas toolbar shows one drama entry.
- Delete NodeEditor, WorkflowHub, /api/workflow/*, workflow-engine,
  workflow-renderer and the workflow image/edit publication code.
- /api/edit rejects assetWorkspace=workflow with 410 before charging.
- Drop @xyflow/react.
- Migration 20261118_wj_remove_node_workflows clears saved workflows,
  strips metadata.workflow from projects and drops the workflow edit tables.
- Remove tests that only covered node mode; mark the three workflow
  protected features as retired.

9c8249e9fef309b55152060ce412160ef80456b0.subjectAndBody:
feat(video): make videos only in the drama workbench, and fold the director layer into it

The canvas video panel, its edit/extend panel and their routes are removed. The canvas
keeps playing, comparing and processing existing videos. Its video entries (toolbar,
Shift+4, command palette, quick create) now open the drama workbench, carrying a typed
idea into the "start from one sentence" form.

/api/video/generate and /api/video/extend no longer wrap the prompt in the director
compiler's LLM instructions (【导演编排】). That text was written for a language model
and went straight to the video model.

What was useful from that layer (Seedance 2.0 Skill OS directing notes) moves into the
drama inspector: a free 润色 action that rewrites one shot through the chat model and
fills shot size, camera move, light and sound, plus fields to edit them. The chosen
values are sent as one "镜头：…" line after the description.
